status: PROPOSAL ONLY; NOT AUTHORIZED TO TRAIN; runner not implemented
experiment: One controlled factor: age-group sampling, two paired arms, no grid
architecture: Unchanged MobileNetV3-Large alpha1,112 RGB0..255,128 embedding,98 ordered thresholds ages1..99,ordinal BCE; unchanged scalar expected-age export
cache_requirement: New shared train/validation-only cache, corrected original YuNet BGR/xywh/.75/.3/IoU.5; margin.45 clamp/int; direct cv2 bilinear112 RGB contract. Never reuse legacy64px cache as current runtime-faithful cache.
sampling: Select variant using fixed mixture; choose age group proportional to successful train rows in variant times group weight; choose uniform source within group/variant with replacement. Log realized source/group/variant draws. No loss weighting.
optimizer: fresh Adam learning_rate1e-4 in both arms; no warmup, BN frozen; no LR search/scheduler over this fixed three-epoch experiment
selection: Final epoch3 only if safety checks pass; no best-of-epochs selection. Epoch1 safety report only. Control and treatment both restart exact v4 checkpoint.
evaluation: Paired unchanged v4/control/treatment on same new corrected validation crops. Conditional MAE/within7/signed mean; E2E within7 and gate counts; groups overall,0-17,18-54,55-80,81+ diagnostic; each115/57/38 plus pooled; all ages1..99 and0..80 sensitivity.

gates.largest_gain: elderly pooled within7 improvement over v4 must exceed adult and child improvements
gates.uncertainty: 1000 paired source-group bootstrap replicates,95% CI of pooled elderly within7 delta vs v4 and vs control must exclude0; inconclusive means no success claim
gates.metric_denominators: All within7 gates use E2E; MAE and signed mean conditional on fixed shared detections.

stops: No training before proposal response and subsequent user authorization
Fail closed on split/source/hash/decode near-duplicate collision, cache mismatch, nonfinite outputs/loss/gradient, ordinal monotonicity violations or changed immutable hashes
After epoch1, stop an arm on child per-size regression >1pp or MAE >.3y vs v4; other arm cannot be claimed successful without comparable completed control
Maximum3 epochs each,6 total; no retries with other weights/LRs/seeds, no automatic continuation
No Phase1/frozen predictions or labels in training/model selection; no external test rerun in this experiment
No export/conversion/default promotion without separate scope
pending: Implement dedicated runner and shared cache builder with explicit guards
Audit decoded/perceptual duplicates for train/validation/external using source images only and freeze audit manifest; existing evidence covers source IDs and encoded SHA256, not identities
Generate corrected independent validation cache and record v4 baseline raw predictions once
Report actual corrected train histogram; weights stay fixed, no adjustment from validation/test errors
